description: Generic light control. Holds the logic common to every lamp and delegates the communication to an attached implementation block, which is the only part that knows a given brand or model.

inputs.name: Power
inputs.description: Switches the light on when high and off when low

inputs.name: Color mode
inputs.description: Low - white light at the requested color temperature, high - color given by hue and saturation. A lamp without color stays white.

inputs.name: Color temperature
inputs.description: Requested color temperature of the white light in kelvins, narrowed down to what the lamp supports. Ignored by lamps without adjustable white.

inputs.name: Hue
inputs.description: Requested hue in color mode, 0 to 360 °

inputs.name: Saturation
inputs.description: Requested saturation in color mode, 0 to 100 %

outputs.name: Power
outputs.description: High when the light is on. Reported by the lamp when the implementation provides feedback, otherwise the commanded state.

outputs.name: Color mode
outputs.description: High when the lamp shows a color, low when it shows white light

outputs.name: Color temperature
outputs.description: Color temperature of the white light in kelvins. The commanded value while the lamp shows a color or does not report it.

outputs.name: Hue
outputs.description: Hue of the lamp in °. The commanded value when the lamp does not report it.

outputs.name: Saturation
outputs.description: Saturation of the lamp in %. The commanded value when the lamp does not report it.

outputs.name: Fault
outputs.description: 0 - no fault, -1 - lamp unreachable, above 0 - implementation specific error code

config.name: Features
config.description: What the lamp can do, each level including the previous ones: on/off, brightness, white color temperature, color. Inputs beyond it are ignored and the matching outputs read -1 (color mode low).

state.name: Reported power
state.description: Power state reported by the implementation block: -1 unknown, 0 off, 1 on

state.name: Reported brightness
state.description: Brightness reported by the implementation block, -1 when unknown

state.name: Reported color mode
state.description: Color mode reported by the implementation block: -1 unknown, 0 white, 1 color

state.name: Reported color temperature
state.description: Color temperature reported by the implementation block, -1 when unknown

state.name: Reported hue
state.description: Hue reported by the implementation block, -1 when unknown

state.name: Reported saturation
state.description: Saturation reported by the implementation block, -1 when unknown

state.name: Reported fault
state.description: Fault reported by the implementation block

state.name: Last implementation result
state.description: Value returned by the last implementation call, published as a fault when the lamp reports none

state.name: State sent
state.description: Set once the state has been accepted by the lamp at least once

state.name: Sent power
state.description: Last power state accepted by the lamp

state.name: Sent brightness
state.description: Last brightness accepted by the lamp

state.name: Sent color mode
state.description: Last color mode accepted by the lamp

state.name: Sent color temperature
state.description: Last color temperature accepted by the lamp

state.name: Sent hue
state.description: Last hue accepted by the lamp

state.name: Sent saturation
state.description: Last saturation accepted by the lamp
